doc.description:
AirData interface. Combines the barometers, differential pressure, airspeed and temperature sensors, like the IMU combines the gyros, accelerometers and magnetometers.
The drivers send their raw values with their own ABI sender ids (BARO_ABS_RAW, BARO_DIFF_RAW, AIRSPEED_RAW and TEMPERATURE_RAW). Per sensor air_data low-pass filters the raw value and applies the calibration (value = (filter(raw) - offset) * scale), selects the sensor to use (the one of the setting, otherwise the first healthy one in the order of the airframe calibration) and sends it with AIR_DATA_SENDER_ID as BARO_ABS, BARO_DIFF, AIRSPEED and TEMPERATURE. It falls back to the next healthy sensor when one stops sending. It also calculates QNH, true airspeed and AMSL (AltitudeAboveSeaLevel) to fly on "flight levels".
The calibration (at boot and with the Calibrate setting) zeroes the differential pressures and lines up the barometers with the one in use, so switching barometers gives no altitude step. It is refused while the motors are armed, unless calib_armed. At boot the sensors with an offset in the airframe keep it.
It is loaded automatically (by the barometers, pitots, INS and the ap and simulation targets), add it to the airframe only to configure it.
Calibration in the airframe, in a section with prefix AIR_DATA_, for example: <define name="DIFF_CALIB" value="{{.abi_id=MS45XX_SENDER_ID, .calibrated={.offset=true}, .offset=12.3, .filter_freq=2}}"/> The filter is a second order Butterworth at the measured rate of the sensor. Without .filter_freq a sensor uses the default of its type (AIR_DATA_*_FILTER_FREQ), a negative .filter_freq turns it off.

define.name: AIR_DATA_BARO_CALIB
define.description: calibration of the barometers, also their priority

define.name: AIR_DATA_DIFF_CALIB
define.description: calibration of the differential pressure sensors, the scale is the pitot correction

define.name: AIR_DATA_AIRSPEED_CALIB
define.description: calibration of the airspeed sensors

define.name: AIR_DATA_TEMP_CALIB
define.description: calibration of the temperatures

define.name: AIR_DATA_BARO_FILTER_FREQ
define.description: default low-pass cut-off of the barometers in Hz, 0 for none (default: 0)

define.name: AIR_DATA_DIFF_FILTER_FREQ
define.description: default low-pass cut-off of the differential pressures in Hz, 0 for none (default: 1)

define.name: AIR_DATA_AIRSPEED_FILTER_FREQ
define.description: default low-pass cut-off of the airspeed sensors in Hz, 0 for none (default: 0)

define.name: AIR_DATA_TEMP_FILTER_FREQ
define.description: default low-pass cut-off of the temperatures in Hz, 0 for none (default: 0)

define.name: AIR_DATA_BARO_ID
define.description: barometer to use (default: ABI_BROADCAST, the first healthy one)

define.name: AIR_DATA_AIRSPEED_ID
define.description: differential pressure or airspeed sensor to use (default: ABI_BROADCAST, the first healthy one)

define.name: AIR_DATA_TEMP_ID
define.description: temperature to use (default: ABI_BROADCAST, an air temperature probe, then a pitot, then a barometer)

define.name: AIR_DATA_BARO_SEND_ID
define.description: barometer in the BARO_RAW telemetry (default: ABI_BROADCAST, all in turn; ABI_DISABLE for none)

define.name: AIR_DATA_AIRSPEED_SEND_ID
define.description: airspeed sensor in the AIRSPEED_RAW telemetry (default: ABI_BROADCAST, all in turn; ABI_DISABLE for none)

define.name: AIR_DATA_SEND_ALL_SENSORS
define.description: also send every calibrated sensor with its own ABI id (default: FALSE)

define.name: AIR_DATA_TIMEOUT
define.description: minimum time in s without a valid value before a sensor is unhealthy

define.name: AIR_DATA_TIMEOUT_FACTOR
define.description: a sensor is unhealthy without a valid value for this times its interval

define.name: AIR_DATA_ALIGN_NB
define.description: number of values to line up a barometer that starts after the calibration

define.name: AIR_DATA_DIFF_MAX
define.description: differential pressures above this (Pa) are ignored

define.name: AIR_DATA_CALIB_AT_BOOT
define.description: calibrate at boot (default: TRUE)

define.name: AIR_DATA_CALIB_BOOT_DELAY
define.description: time after boot of the calibration in s

define.name: AIR_DATA_CALIB_TIME
define.description: calibration time in s

define.name: AIR_DATA_CALIB_ARMED
define.description: allow the calibration while armed (default: FALSE)

define.name: USE_AIRSPEED_AIR_DATA
define.description: set airspeed in state interface (default: TRUE)
